description: Design Health — runs 19 deterministic quality checks on HTML output. Use when the user says /reimagine-it audit, "audit this page", "check design quality", or wants to verify craft-floor compliance before shipping. Catches blank plates, missing focus rings, non-compositor motion, off-palette accents, dead motion, fabricated content. No LLM, no API key. CI-ready with --json and exit codes. Part of the reimagine-it Content-Derived Design suite.
